repair_of: unit-v3.json (the weak gate covered only SUBSTITUTED realizations, so a hollow root whose weak radical stood LITERALLY in a Form-I template passed as if the root were sound — the uncontracted hollow shapes are non-words; and a weak declaration contradicting the supplied radicals was silently ignored — Sol round 3)

rules.text: a template matches only with supplied root radicals filling R1..R3 in order (no root derivation in the consumer)
mu_participle without a known penult vowel -> abstain penult_vowel_unknown (never default to active)
gloss SHAPE is nominal for every class here; the consumer flags (does not author) any verbal-gloss pairing
zero or >1 surviving template -> abstain (ambiguous_template or no_template)

every realization of a weak radical is licensed per template, slot and radical by weak_realizations.by_template: an altered letter must appear in that entry's substituted list, and a weak radical may stand literally only where literal_licensed is true; nothing is licensed by default
a claimed penult surface mark must be verifiable on the written surface: unpointed -> penult_mark_not_in_surface; differing written mark -> penult_mark_mismatch (never trust the claim alone)

every weak radical of the matched template requires the exact bound declaration (weak_position + weak_radical) -> otherwise weak_declaration_unbound; an unlicensed realization -> weak_realization_unlicensed
a weak declaration that the supplied radicals do not bear is contradictory evidence, not a harmless extra -> weak_declaration_contradicts_root

weak_realizations.licensing_note: DELIBERATELY MINIMAL. Only realizations this increment holds committed fixture evidence for are licensed; every other weak realization abstains. Widening this table is a linguistic decision for the ṣarf authority (adp-sarf-nahw-authority), made in DATA — no consumer edit is required to license a further realization.
